entries.title: Mark 15:1
segments: ¶Immediately, in the morning, the chief priests held a consultation with the elders and scribes and the whole council; and they bound Jesus, led [Him] away, and delivered [Him] to Pilate.

entries.title: Mark 15:2
segments: Then Pilate asked Him, "Are You the King of the Jews?" He answered and said to him, "[It is as] you say."

entries.title: Mark 15:3
segments: And the chief priests accused Him of many things, but He answered nothing.

entries.title: Mark 15:4
segments: Then Pilate asked Him again, saying, "Do You answer nothing? See how many things they testify against You!"

entries.title: Mark 15:5
segments: But Jesus still answered nothing, so that Pilate marveled.

entries.title: Mark 15:6
segments: Now at the feast he was accustomed to releasing one prisoner to them, whomever they requested.

entries.title: Mark 15:7
segments: And there was one named Barabbas, [who was] chained with his fellow rebels; they had committed murder in the rebellion.

entries.title: Mark 15:8
segments: Then the multitude, crying aloud, began to ask [him to do] just as he had always done for them.

entries.title: Mark 15:9
segments: But Pilate answered them, saying, "Do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?"

entries.title: Mark 15:10
segments: For he knew that the chief priests had handed Him over because of envy.

entries.title: Mark 15:11
segments: But the chief priests stirred up the crowd, so that he should rather release Barabbas to them.

entries.title: Mark 15:12
segments: Pilate answered and said to them again, "What then do you want me to do [with Him] whom you call the King of the Jews?"

entries.title: Mark 15:13
segments: So they cried out again, "Crucify Him!"

entries.title: Mark 15:14
segments: Then Pilate said to them, "Why, what evil has He done?" But they cried out all the more, "Crucify Him!"

entries.title: Mark 15:15
segments: ¶So Pilate, wanting to gratify the crowd, released Barabbas to them; and he delivered Jesus, after he had scourged [Him], to be crucified.

entries.title: Mark 15:16
segments: Then the soldiers led Him away into the hall called Praetorium, and they called together the whole garrison.

entries.title: Mark 15:17
segments: And they clothed Him with purple; and they twisted a crown of thorns, put it on His [head],

entries.title: Mark 15:18
segments: and began to salute Him, "Hail, King of the Jews!"

entries.title: Mark 15:19
segments: Then they struck Him on the head with a reed and spat on Him; and bowing the knee, they worshiped Him.

entries.title: Mark 15:20
segments: And when they had mocked Him, they took the purple off Him, put His own clothes on Him, and led Him out to crucify Him.

entries.title: Mark 15:21
segments: Then they compelled a certain man, Simon a Cyrenian, the father of Alexander and Rufus, as he was coming out of the country and passing by, to bear His cross.

entries.title: Mark 15:22
segments: ¶And they brought Him to the place Golgotha, which is translated, Place of a Skull.

entries.title: Mark 15:23
segments: Then they gave Him wine mingled with myrrh to drink, but He did not take [it].

entries.title: Mark 15:24
segments: And when they crucified Him, they divided His garments, casting lots for them to determine what every man should take.

entries.title: Mark 15:25
segments: Now it was the third hour, and they crucified Him.

entries.title: Mark 15:26
segments: And the inscription of His accusation was written above: THE KING OF THE JEWS.

entries.title: Mark 15:27
segments: With Him they also crucified two robbers, one on His right and the other on His left.

entries.title: Mark 15:28
segments: So the Scripture was fulfilled which says, "And He was numbered with the transgressors."

entries.title: Mark 15:29
segments: And those who passed by blasphemed Him, wagging their heads and saying, "Aha! [You] who destroy the temple and build [it] in three days,

entries.title: Mark 15:30
segments: "save Yourself, and come down from the cross!"

entries.title: Mark 15:31
segments: Likewise the chief priests also, mocking among themselves with the scribes, said, "He saved others; Himself He cannot save.

entries.title: Mark 15:32
segments: "Let the Christ, the King of Israel, descend now from the cross, that we may see and believe." Even those who were crucified with Him reviled Him.

entries.title: Mark 15:33
segments: ¶Now when the sixth hour had come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.

entries.title: Mark 15:34
segments: And at the ninth hour Jesus cried out with a loud voice, saying, "Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani?" which is translated, "My God, My God, why have You forsaken Me?"

entries.title: Mark 15:35
segments: Some of those who stood by, when they heard [that], said, "Look, He is calling for Elijah!"

entries.title: Mark 15:36
segments: Then someone ran and filled a sponge full of sour wine, put [it] on a reed, and offered [it] to Him to drink, saying, "Let Him alone; let us see if Elijah will come to take Him down."

entries.title: Mark 15:37
segments: And Jesus cried out with a loud voice, and breathed His last.

entries.title: Mark 15:38
segments: Then the veil of the temple was torn in two from top to bottom.

entries.title: Mark 15:39
segments: So when the centurion, who stood opposite Him, saw that He cried out like this and breathed His last, he said, "Truly this Man was the Son of God!"

entries.title: Mark 15:40
segments: There were also women looking on from afar, among whom were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James the Less and of Joses, and Salome,

entries.title: Mark 15:41
segments: who also followed Him and ministered to Him when He was in Galilee, and many other women who came up with Him to Jerusalem.

entries.title: Mark 15:42
segments: ¶Now when evening had come, because it was the Preparation Day, that is, the day before the Sabbath,

entries.title: Mark 15:43
segments: Joseph of Arimathea, a prominent council member, who was himself waiting for the kingdom of God, coming and taking courage, went in to Pilate and asked for the body of Jesus.

entries.title: Mark 15:44
segments: Pilate marveled that He was already dead; and summoning the centurion, he asked him if He had been dead for some time.

entries.title: Mark 15:45
segments: So when he found out from the centurion, he granted the body to Joseph.

entries.title: Mark 15:46
segments: Then he bought fine linen, took Him down, and wrapped Him in the linen. And he laid Him in a tomb which had been hewn out of the rock, and rolled a stone against the door of the tomb.

entries.title: Mark 15:47
segments: And Mary Magdalene and Mary [the mother] of Joses observed where He was laid.
